Reaching eligibility takes 81 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. Slashing removes 38 percent at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
